agents.name: Search places by what, name or where
agents.description: Finds places by what they are, name, street address or locality, at most 20, with coordinates and the geoHash and id get_place takes. query matches a word of a place's category (barber finds a barber shop, salon a hair salon) or a word of its name, not its address (use address for streets). Each term is a prefix of 3+ characters; a shorter one is ignored and appliedTerms lists what matched. With latitude and longitude: nearest first within radiusKm (default 5, max 50), and no country unless you pass countryCode. A point alone is refused or returns nothing. Without a point the search stays in one country: pass countryCode when you know the user's, because the default is the caller's network country, for a hosted agent the provider's. claimedOnly keeps claimed places, the only ones that can take bookings; get_place says whether one does. Requires a signed-in user.
reasons: The tool can find places by category, and 'salon' matches 'hair salon'.
uncertainties: Execution requires a fresh readiness check.

agents.name: Score a barbershop, salon, school or supply store's Google listing
agents.description: Score a named barbershop, salon, barber/cosmetology school or beauty supply store's public Google Business Profile and return what is missing, ranked. Compares photos, reviews, rating, hours, website and phone against other listings in the same city — the local median is computed from our own directory and is not published anywhere. Returns a coverage figure with the score because the public tier can only see part of the full audit; never present the score as a complete audit.
